Short title extent and commencement

THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913
THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913.
ACT No. V of 1913
[7th Match, 1913]
An Act to prohibit the importation, manufacture and sale of matches
made with white phosphorus.
1. Short title extent and commencement. ‑(1) This Act may be
called the White Phosphorus Matches Prohibition Act, 1913.
Subs. by
the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd
Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for the original sub‑section
(2) as amended by A. O., 1949, Arts. 3 (2) and 4. [(2) It extends to the
whole of Pakistan.]
(3) It shall come into force on
the first day of July, 1913, with the exception of section 6, which shall come
into force on the first day of July, 1914.

Definition

THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913
THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913.
ACT No. V of 1913
[7th Match, 1913]
An Act to prohibit the importation, manufacture and sale of matches
made with white phosphorus.
2. Definition In this Act, " white phosphorus " means the
substance commonly known as white or yellow phosphorus.

Prohibition of use of white phosphorous in manufacture of matches

THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913
THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913.
ACT No. V of 1913
[7th Match, 1913]
An Act to prohibit the importation, manufacture and sale of matches
made with white phosphorus.
4. Prohibition of use of white phosphorous in manufacture of matches--‑(1)
No person shall use white phosphorus in the manufacture of matches.
(2) Any person who uses, or
permits the use by any person under his control, of white phosphorus in the
manufacture of matches, shall be punishable with fine which may extend to two
hundred rupees.

punishable with fine which may extend to two

sections.description:
Power of Inspector of Factories

THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913
THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913.
ACT No. V of 1913
[7th Match, 1913]
An Act to prohibit the importation, manufacture and sale of matches
made with white phosphorus.
5. Power of Inspector of Factories--(1) Every person who
manufactures matches shall allow an Inspector of Factories appointed under the
Indian Factories
Act, 1911(See
now the Factories Act, 1934 (25 of 1934)), at any time to take for
analysis sufficient samples of any material in use or mixed for use, in such
manufacture:
Provided that any such person
may, at the time the sample is taken, and on providing the necessary
appliances, require the Inspector to divide the sample so taken into two parts,
and to mark, seal and deliver to him one part.
(2) Any person who refuses to
permit any such Inspector of Factories as aforesaid to take a sample, in
accordance with the provisions of sub‑section (1), shall be punishable
with fine which may extend to two hundred rupees.
sections.punishment:
punishable
with fine which may extend to two hundred rupees.

sections.description:
Prohibition of sale

THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913
THE WHITE PHOSPHORUS MATCHES PROHIBITION ACT, 1913.
ACT No. V of 1913
[7th Match, 1913]
An Act to prohibit the importation, manufacture and sale of matches
made with white phosphorus.
6. Prohibition of sale (1)
No person shall sell, or offer or expose for sale, or have in his possession
for the purposes of sale, any matches made with white phosphorus.
(2) Any person who contravenes
the provisions of sub section (1) may, on complaint to a The words Presidency Magistrate omitted by A.O., 1949 Sch.*
*, Sub‑divisional Magis trate or Magistrate of the first class, be
ordered to forfeit any such matches in his possession, and any matches so
forfeited shall be destroyed or otherwise dealt with as the Magistrate may
direct.
